definitions.explanation: One of the back legs of a four-legged animal (or the back legs of an insect or frog).

examples.english: The dog stood on its hind legs.
The cat hurt its hind leg.

examples.japanese: ⟦カエル→カエル：28199_kaeru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後|うし}ろ{足|あし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{遠|とお}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{跳|と}べる→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Frogs have strong hind legs, so they can jump a long way.

notes:
Also written {後足|あとあし} and read あとあし, with the same meaning. The idiom {後足|あとあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける (literally "to kick sand with the hind legs") means to do someone a bad turn as you leave them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後|うし}ろ{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the hind legs
- {後|うし}ろ{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧: to kick with the hind legs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前足|まえあし}→前足：29904_maeashi⟧: foreleg, front paw
